∀ (P : Nat → Prop), (∀ (a : Nat), (∀ (b : Nat), (((a = b) ∧ (P a)) → (P b))))
∀ (xs : List Nat) (ys : List Nat), ((((List.nil : List Nat) ++ xs) = xs) ∧ (((List.nil : List Nat) ++ ys) = ys))
∀ (xs : List Nat), (∀ (n : Nat), ((List.length (List.cons n xs)) = (Nat.succ (List.length xs))))
∀ (xs : List Nat) (ys : List Nat), (((xs ++ (List.nil : List Nat)) = xs) ∧ ((ys ++ (List.nil : List Nat)) = ys))
